review_candidates.description: Integration Architect — Unified Data Platform (UDP) Location: Dubai, UAE Level: Senior / Principal We are seeking a Senior Integration Architect to lead the integration architecture for a Unified Data Platform (UDP) within a healthcare environment. The role will own the design of middleware, interfaces, APIs, and secure data-exchange patterns connecting EHR/HIS, LIS, RIS/PACS, pharmacy, claims, and Health Information Exchange (HIE) platforms. Key Responsibilities Define integration architecture, interface requirements, data flows, and integration patterns across healthcare source systems. Design and implement middleware/interface-engine architecture, including routing, transformation, queuing, retries, and error handling. Develop HLD/LLD, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), field mappings, and transformation specifications. Ensure interoperability using HL7 v2/v3, FHIR R4, DICOM, and IHE profiles (PIX/PDQ, XDS.b) . Design REST/SOAP APIs and API gateway policies, including authentication, versioning, and security. Support integration with regional/national HIE platforms such as Malaffi, Riayati , or equivalent. Establish integration monitoring, alerting, observability, and interface-health dashboards. Ensure secure integration using OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, and encryption , aligned with applicable UAE healthcare data/privacy requirements. Coordinate integration testing, conformance testing, and go-live activities with vendors and client teams. Partner closely with Solution Architects, Data Engineering, Business Analysis, and Technical Project Management teams. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field. 10–14 years of IT experience , including 5+ years as an Integration Architect in healthcare/health IT. Strong hands-on expertise in HL7, FHIR, DICOM, and IHE standards. Experience with integration platforms such as Mirth/NextGen Connect, InterSystems IRIS/Ensemble, Rhapsody, MuleSoft, Azure, or AWS . Strong REST/SOAP API and API management experience. Experience with healthcare HIE integration; Malaffi/Riayati or GCC HIE experience preferred . Knowledge of UAE healthcare data privacy requirements and DDA data classification/interoperability guidelines. Good understanding of OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, and data encryption . English fluency required; Arabic is an advantage. UAE availability preferred. HL7/FHIR, TOGAF, or cloud integration certifications are a plus.

review_candidates.description: Nội dung công việc - Truyền tải nội dung cho dev team, QA và quản lý tiến độ, chất lượng dự án. - Là cầu nối giữa khách hàng Nhật Bản và đội dự án offshore tại Việt Nam. - Làm việc trực tiếp với khách hàng Nhật: giao tiếp, thương lượng, tiếp nhận và phân tích yêu cầu dự án phần mềm, sau đó truyền đạt cho đội dự án tại Việt Nam. - Lập kế hoạch, theo dõi tiến độ. - Kiểm soát tiến độ thực hiện dự án, phối hợp với khách hàng và giám đốc dự án trong việc quản lý dự án. 2.Yêu cầu công việc - Có kiến thức cơ bản về lập trình. - Tiếng Nhật từ N2 trở lên. - Đọc hiểu spec, tài liệu kỹ thuật, viết được meeting minutes/ Q&A sheet/ spec confirmation chuẩn ngữ cảnh dự án - không chỉ dịch từng câu. - AI-first mindset - Thành thạo các AI tools trong workflow hàng ngày: ChatGPT/ Claude (soạn thảo, review). Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm Claude code/ Cursor/ GitHub Copilot. Dùng AI để tăng tốc nhưng tự review output - không gửi raw AI cho khách hàng. Kinh nghiệm - Có kinh nghiệm làm Comtor từ 2 năm trở lên. - Từng tham gia dự án phần mềm thực tế, hiểu luồng SDLC cơ bản, đọc được spec/wireframe/ERD. Có khả năng phát hiện gap, miscommunication giữa 2 phía dev và khách hàng. Yêu cầu khác - Nhiệt tình, hòa đồng, có khả năng làm việc nhóm tốt. - Khả năng đọc hiểu yêu cầu tốt, giao tiếp hiệu quả. - Cầu thị trong công việc, có tinh thần trách nhiệm cao. - Năng động, sáng tạo, chủ động cập nhật và thử nghiệm công nghệ AI mới. 3.Chế độ đãi ngộ - Lương: Up to 30.000.000 VNĐ/ tháng - Xét tăng lương 1 lần/ năm, có thể được xét tăng sớm tùy thuộc vào năng lực và hiệu quả công việc. - Lương tháng 13 theo hiệu suất công việc và tình hình kinh doanh công ty, thưởng dự án và các loại thưởng khác (Thưởng thành tích, thưởng cá nhân xuất sắc, thưởng đạt chứng chỉ ngoại ngữ/chuyên môn từ 1.000.000 VNĐ - 5.000.000 VNĐ) - Được làm việc trực tiếp với các khách hàng Nhật Bản. Cơ hội Onsite tại Nhật Bản. - Được hưởng các phúc lợi khác như: Team-building hàng tháng, nghỉ mát hàng năm, khám sức khỏe định kỳ... - Tất cả chế độ theo quy định của Pháp luật Lao động Việt Nam (BHXH, BHYT, BHTN, ...). - Nghỉ phép năm và các ngày nghỉ lễ Tết khác theo quy định của nhà nước Việt Nam. - Làm việc từ thứ 2 đến thứ 6. - Môi trường làm việc trẻ trung, năng động. review_candidates.title: Training Program Manager
review_candidates.description: ■Training Program Director / Chief Technical Advisor — Power & Energy Capacity Development ●Duty Location: Syria | Period of Performance: 12 Months | ●Status: Full-Time, In-Country ●Citizenship: U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED ●Security: Active U.S. Secret clearance or higher strongly preferred; at minimum, candidate must be demonstrably eligible and able to obtain/maintain a Secret clearance ■POSITION SUMMARY: CRG seeks a senior Training Program Director / Chief Technical Advisor (CTA) to lead the design, mobilization, technical governance, and delivery of a national-level power and energy technical training and institutional capacity-development program in Syria. This is the program’s senior technical and training authority. The selected candidate will translate department/division missions, workforce competencies, infrastructure condition, asset inventories, operational requirements, and institutional priorities into an executable training architecture. The CTA will direct multidisciplinary SMEs developing and delivering training across grid systems, transmission, substations, protection and control, SCADA/telecom, laboratories, renewable energy, energy efficiency, MRV, asset management, project controls, procurement, QA/QC, technical documentation, and train-the-trainer disciplines. This is not a classroom-instructor position. It requires an executive-level technical leader capable of integrating power-sector engineering, workforce development, program management, stakeholder engagement, and delivery assurance in a complex operating environment. ■MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS: Candidates must meet the following threshold requirements. Only qualified candidates will be contacted. ●U.S. Citizen. ●Active Secret clearance or higher preferred; otherwise demonstrably clearable to Secret level. ●15+ years of progressively responsible experience across power, energy, utilities, national laboratories, engineering, infrastructure, technical training, or related mission environments. ●Demonstrated leadership of large-scale, multi-discipline technical programs, preferably involving national or regional energy infrastructure. ●Proven ability to conduct or direct training-needs analyses, competency mapping, curriculum architecture, technical qualification programs, practical assessments, and train-the-trainer systems. ●Working knowledge of power-sector functions including generation interfaces, transmission, HV/MV substations, protection/control, SCADA, asset management, maintenance, laboratories, energy data, and project delivery. ●Experience directing multidisciplinary engineers, instructors, technical SMEs, curriculum developers, and program-support personnel. ●Prior work in austere, post-conflict, expeditionary, OCONUS, or politically sensitive environments. ●Executive-level ability to engage ministries, government agencies, utilities, laboratories, EPCs, donors, technical institutions, and senior stakeholders. ●Ability and willingness to reside and work in Syria and travel regionally as mission requirements dictate. ■HIGHLY PREFERRED ●Former U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), DOE National Laboratory, federal energy program, major U.S. utility, ISO/RTO, OEM, EPC, or owner’s-engineer leadership experience. ●Former U.S. Military personnel will receive preference, particularly candidates with engineering, energy, infrastructure, facilities, logistics, training, or program-management backgrounds. ●Experience supporting institutional rebuilding, infrastructure rehabilitation, workforce modernization, or sovereign capacity-development programs. ●PMP, PE, CEng, instructional-system-design, energy-management, or comparable senior professional credentials. ■KEY RESPONSIBILITIES ●Serve as CRG’s principal technical authority and senior client interface for the training program. ●Conduct and govern the initial department/division training-needs and workforce competency baseline. ●Align training priorities to verified asset condition, infrastructure readiness, equipment availability, workforce roles, safety requirements, and operational needs. ●Establish the Training Master Plan, competency framework, course sequencing, prerequisites, delivery standards, and qualification methodology. ●Task, manage, and technically review SME-developed training packages, instructor guides, participant materials, practical exercises, assessments, SOPs, and supporting technical documentation. ●Integrate training across electrical safety; transmission; substations; protection/control; SCADA; laboratories/calibration; renewables; efficiency; energy data/MRV; maintenance; procurement; project controls; QA/QC; and technical documentation. ●Establish measurable KPIs, competency assessments, training records, lessons learned, corrective actions, and continuous-improvement controls. ●Develop sustainable train-the-trainer and knowledge-transfer mechanisms that progressively institutionalize capability within Syrian organizations. ●Maintain rigorous program discipline across quality, safety, security, compliance, schedule, cost, risk, reporting, and stakeholder coordination. ■EDUCATION: ●Bachelor’s degree required in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Energy Systems, Engineering Management, Education/Training Systems, or a directly relevant discipline. ●Advanced technical or management degree preferred. ■CANDIDATE PROFILE: ●CRG is seeking a builder and integrator—someone who can assess the current state, architect the future state, organize the right SMEs, establish standards, develop institutional capability, and drive the program from initial baseline through sustained execution. ●Only candidates meeting the mandatory citizenship, security, seniority, technical-leadership, and Syria deployment requirements will be contacted.
